-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Demon Fire Magic.png  |title= Demon Fire Magic |kanji= 魔炎魔法 |romaji= Maen Mahō |english= Devil Flame Magic (VIZ)  |user= #Nahamah }} {{Nihongo|Demon Fire Magic|魔炎魔法|Maen Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of Fire Magic.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of fire at will. The flames are capable of burning anything and everything, including shadows, light, and even invisible concepts. The user 
    Superior overall to its regular Fire Magic counterpart, this fire is extremely deadly and versatile, from shooting a barrage of flame bullets, releasing waves of blazing fire, creating a twister that incinerates anything
